description: A React component for handling Paddle checkout in the Notesnook project, including checkout creation, coupon application, event handling, and iframe rendering.

methods.name: PaddleCheckout
methods.description: React component managing Paddle checkout flow, iframe rendering, and event handling.

methods.name: getCheckoutURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the Paddle checkout iframe based on checkout ID and theme.

methods.name: getPricingInfo
methods.description: Extracts and formats pricing information from checkout data.

methods.name: createCheckout
methods.description: Initiates checkout creation via API, including customer info and coupon application.

methods.name: submitCustomerInfo
methods.description: Submits customer address and email to the checkout API.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a discount coupon to the checkout session.

methods.name: removeDiscount
methods.description: Removes a discount from the checkout session.
